text:
At midnight there came a note from Ryan, which said that we must talk; and I knew at once what such a request meant.

The next day we met at a house of refreshment in the town, where he was before me, attending to the little instrument in his hand, and looking nervous; and he said that he was not ready for anything serious, and that the fault was not mine, but his own.

I wished to cry, but did not; I only nodded, and said that it was all right, and then walked home in the rain, and ate a whole pint of ice cream.

My friend, who shared my room, thought that I made too much of it; perhaps I did, but it hurt me still.
